events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot in Las Vegas
events.blurb: On September 7th, 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the raw talent and enduring impact of Tupac Shakur, shot on this day in '96. His music and message still resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: September 18th marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, the guitar virtuoso who redefined music. His legacy lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26th, 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh as the day it dropped. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' – an album that truly defined a generation, 57 years young today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the iconic Chrissie Hynde – still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still got it.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album: 55 Years
events.blurb: John Lennon's poignant second studio album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8th, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: A timeless message of peace and hope. John Lennon's 'Imagine' album – still resonating 55 years later.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: On October 23rd, 2001, Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Remember The Click Wheel?
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years since the original iPod dropped and changed the game for portable music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Licence To Thrill
angles.copy: Licence to thrill! Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese. Still making us laugh!

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22nd, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: A sprawling masterpiece. The Beatles' 'White Album' – a landmark release that still sounds incredible 58 years on.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, a voice and stage presence that truly defined rock and roll.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3rd, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' – still sounding fresh 61 years after its release.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks the tragic anniversary of the death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose profound impact on music and culture continues to inspire generations.
